goal: Remove the redundant navigation chrome from the docs sidebar and the header nav, on both the docs layout and the landing
context: The docs sidebar currently stacks three duplicate top-level nav rows (Docs / Quickstart / CLI reference), a marketing banner, and a custom footer above and around the real page tree. The same three links are also repeated in the landing header next to a hero CTA that already points at the quickstart. All three pieces come from one shared config plus one small component file. Remove them and leave the chrome that actually earns its place. Verified in the DOM snapshot: on /docs/getting-started/quickstart both the "Docs" and the "Quickstart" rows render an active pill simultaneously, which is the clearest symptom of the duplication.

targets.selector: baseOptions().links — rendered as #nd-nav ul on / and as the three full-width rows above "Climier documentation" in #nd-sidebar on /docs/**
targets.intent: Remove the three top-level nav links entirely ("Docs", "Quickstart", "CLI reference") so neither the landing header nor the docs sidebar repeats them. The docs sidebar still reaches /docs through its "Climier documentation" root link and its page tree; the landing still reaches the docs through the hero CTA, the in-page links, and the footer columns.
targets.notes: src/lib/layout.shared.tsx is the single source of truth: the links array feeds HomeLayout on / and DocsLayout on /docs/**. Keep the logo/title, keep githubUrl, keep search. Do not add a replacement link.

targets.intent: Remove the banner completely, so the page tree is the first thing under search.
targets.notes: SidebarBanner in src/components/docs-chrome.tsx, wired through DocsLayout's sidebar.banner in src/routes/docs/$.tsx. Remove the wiring too, and leave no empty spacing where it was.

targets.selector: #nd-sidebar div.flex.flex-col.gap-2.text-[13px] (the custom "GitHub · CLI reference" + "MIT licensed · v1.0" block)
targets.intent: Remove the whole custom sidebar footer. GitHub is already reachable from the header icon and from fumadocs' own sidebar pill; "CLI reference" is already in the Reference tree; a hardcoded "v1.0" will go stale.
targets.notes: SidebarFooter in src/components/docs-chrome.tsx, wired through DocsLayout's sidebar.footer in src/routes/docs/$.tsx. IMPORTANT: keep fumadocs' own sidebar control pill — the one that contains the GitHub icon link and the theme "Toggle Theme" button. Only the custom block goes.

constraints: One theme only: this round removes redundant chrome. Do not restyle anything that stays, do not touch content, do not touch the theme tokens.
If src/components/docs-chrome.tsx becomes empty after both exports are gone, delete the file and its import in src/routes/docs/$.tsx. Leave no dead exports, dead imports, or commented-out code.
Do not remove the theme toggle, search, the logo, the GitHub icon, the table of contents, the pagination cards, or fumadocs' sidebar control pill.
Reuse the existing fumadocs layout primitives; do not hand-build replacements.
Hygiene: run `cd docs && bun run typecheck` scoped to your change and report the exact result in hygiene. Do not run the full repo test suite.
acceptanceCriteria: On / the header contains no anchor whose visible text is "Docs", "Quickstart" or "CLI reference"; logo, search, theme toggle and GitHub icon are all still present.
On /docs/getting-started/quickstart the sidebar region above "Climier documentation" contains no nav rows at all — no "Docs", no "Quickstart", no "CLI reference".
The string "New to Climier?" does not exist anywhere in the DOM.
The sidebar contains no visible "GitHub" text link, no "CLI reference" text link, and no "MIT licensed · v1.0".
The fumadocs sidebar control pill (theme Toggle Theme button + GitHub icon) still renders and the theme toggle still switches light/dark.
Search still opens on the landing header and in the docs sidebar.
qualityChecks: No leftover vertical gap, stray divider or orphaned padding where the banner and the nav rows used to be — the sidebar reads as one continuous column: search → root link → page groups.
The landing header still looks deliberate and balanced without the link list; the logo stays left and search/theme/GitHub stay right with no empty wrapper shifting the title.

Nothing in the removed set is still referenced as a fallback entry point that a reader would now miss — the surviving paths to the docs (root link, page tree, hero CTA, footer columns) are all still reachable.
Hover and focus-visible states of the surviving sidebar and header items are unchanged.
Removing the pieces did not leave two competing ways to reach the same destination.
regressionChecks: Landing /: hero, the animated climier status panel, the "How the graph stays honest" specimens, the lifecycle section and the footer are visually unchanged.
Docs /docs/getting-started/quickstart: prose, code blocks, the "On this page" TOC, and the prev/next pagination cards are unchanged.
Docs /docs/reference/cli: a long page still renders and scrolls with the same sidebar and TOC behaviour.
Dark mode: sidebar, header and sidebar control pill are coherent after the removal.
Narrow viewport (390x844): the docs sidebar opens and closes and the mobile nav is not broken by the removal.

visualGaps.observed: Three full-width rows duplicating the page tree below them; Docs and Quickstart both show an active pill at the same time on the Quickstart page.
visualGaps.expected: No duplicated top-level nav rows; the sidebar starts at the root link + page tree.

visualGaps.observed: Marketing banner occupies the prime sidebar slot above the tree.
visualGaps.expected: Removed; the tree is the first thing under search.

visualGaps.observed: Custom footer duplicating the header GitHub icon and the Reference tree, plus a hardcoded version string.
visualGaps.expected: Removed, keeping fumadocs' own control pill.

visualGaps.observed: Landing header repeats the same three links next to a hero CTA that already leads to the quickstart.
visualGaps.expected: Header keeps logo + search + theme + GitHub only.
